page.overview:
What is Secret Shore?

The Secret Shore is a location in Hoenn that only appears in Pokémon Omega Ruby and Pokémon Alpha Sapphire. It is located south of Route 129, but requires diving as well as surfing to be reached other than soaring and flying.

It is a beach area with small bodies of shallow water, and stairs leading to six different Super Secret Base spots. No items and wild Pokémon can be found here.
